annotation.title_clean: Procurement Policy Note: Improving Transparency of AI use in Procurement (Information Note 02/24)
annotation.title_en: Procurement Policy Note: Improving Transparency of AI use in Procurement (Information Note 02/24)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Crown Commercial Service / Cabinet Office (UK Government)
annotation.summary_en: UK Procurement Policy Note 02/24 advises central government contracting authorities on managing risks from suppliers' use of AI in tenders and service delivery. It recommends disclosure questions, proportionate due diligence and controls against using confidential data as training data. It is general AI guidance with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Suppliers' use of AI in bids is not prohibited but risks should be understood and managed.
Contracting authorities may ask suppliers to disclose AI use in tenders (example disclosure questions in Annex B).
Apply proportionate controls to prevent confidential tender information being used to train AI.
Conduct additional due diligence where AI is used to create tender responses.
Ask suppliers to declare AI use in 'non-AI' services and manage data use via contract terms.
